notes: 中英双语与英文名 Keepsake：「我的 → 外观 → 语言」可在 Android 13 及以上单独选择语言。新增合集解析（默认关闭，最多 20 条）、字幕下载与内嵌、私有保险箱与应用锁、链接清单导入导出与设置备份恢复。播放器支持双击 ±10 秒、滑动亮度/音量、长按临时 2× 倍速与同名字幕开关，并新增音频睡眠定时器。下载新增全局与单任务限速、完成后自动存入相册（默认关闭）与继续观看进度。弹窗统一为卡片式，存储管理弹窗改版。
notesEn: Chinese and English, with the English name Keepsake: on Android 13 or newer you can pick the language just for the app in My settings → Language. New: collection parsing (off by default, up to 20 entries), subtitle download and embedding, a private vault with app lock, plus link-list import/export and settings backup/restore. The player supports double-tap ±10 s, swipe for brightness or volume, press-and-hold for a temporary 2× speed, a subtitle switch, and a sleep timer for audio. Downloads gain a global and per-task speed limit, optional auto-save to the gallery (off by default) and resume-watching progress. Every dialog uses the same card layout, and the storage dialog was redesigned.
